03/02.12.2025 I.A. (Cr.) No. 6507 of 2025 Heard the learned counsel for the respective parties.
This application has been preferred by the appellant for grant of bail to him during the pendency of this appeal.
The appellant has been convicted for the offence under section 376(D) of the Indian Penal Code and has been sentenced to undergo RI for 20 years along with a fine of Rs.20000/-.
It has been alleged that one Ramlal Bodra had sexually exploited the victim on the pretext of marriage for the last three months.
The victim was taken to Ranchi by a train on 13.11.2019 when Ramlal Bodra as well as the present appellant had dragged the victim towards a river and committed rape upon her.
The victim has been examined as PW-6 and she has specifically stated about the involvement of the appellant in committing rape upon her along with Ramlal Bodra.
It appears that the prayer for bail of the co-convict Ramlal Bodra @ Mejor Bodra has been rejected by this Court in Criminal Appeal (DB) No. 767 of 2025.
Since the case of the present appellant is similarly situated to that of co-convict Ramlal Bodra, we are not inclined to admit the appellant on bail.
His prayer for bail is hereby rejected.

(RONGON MUKHOPADHYAY, J.) (PRADEEP KUMAR SRIVASTAVA, J.) 02.12.2025 S.B.
